A decade of leadership has brought #Huawei to another milestone.
 
Huawei has once again been recognized as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Enterprise Storage Platforms, marking its 10th time in the Leaders quadrant.
 
From AI and all-flash innovation to data resilience, Huawei continues to explore what enterprise storage can deliver in the intelligent era.
 
Join us at #HUAWEICONNECT 2026 and the Data Storage Summit on September 17 in Shanghai to discover what comes next: https://bit.ly/4fSGotw #HuaweiStorage #OceanStor #AI
title: 10 Times a Leader. What's Next for Enterprise Storage?
